 Career 3832 Postdoc Position in Quantum Control of Semiconductor Qubits 
Join the Veldhorst Group, pioneers in germanium-based quantum computing and simulation. Job description 
After a successful first hire for this research topic, we are looking for a second Postdoctoral Researcher to join the Veldhorst Group, who are pioneers in quantum computing and simulation in germanium. The Veldhorst group demonstrated the first single-hole qubit, enabled two-qubit logic in germanium, and executed quantum algorithms on a four-qubit quantum processor. 
As a Postdoc researcher, you will explore opportunities with semiconductor quantum technology and aim to push the boundaries in quantum control of semiconductor qubits. 
The Veldhorst group is a collaborative and supportive research environment where team members work closely together, share expertise, and mentor one another while advancing the field of semiconductor quantum technology. 
Near-term projects include multi-qubit operation, entanglement generation between qubit registers, and multi-quantum wells for higher dimensional quantum systems. Requirements 
You have a PhD degree in physics, applied physics, nanoelectronics or comparable discipline at the time of taking on the position. Prior experience in solid-state quantum computing, spin qubits, or superconducting qubits would be beneficial but is not required. 
Doing a Postdoc at TU Delft requires English proficiency at a certain level to ensure that the candidate is able to communicate and interact well, participate in English-taught Doctoral Education courses, and write scientific articles and a final thesis. For more details please check the Graduate Schools Admission Requirements.

Do you enjoy motivating people, taking responsibility and making sure warehouse operations run smoothly? 
For a fast-growing international logistics company in Veghel , we are looking for a motivated Team Leader to strengthen the warehouse team. 
About the company 
You will be working for an international logistics organization specializing in global order fulfillment. The warehouse handles products from industries such as fashion, footwear, handbags, accessories, cosmetics, home goods, medical devices and supplements . 
What will you do? 
As a Team Leader, you will be responsible for the daily coordination of your warehouse team. You will help ensure that targets are achieved while maintaining quality and a positive working environment. 
Your responsibilities include: - Coordinating and supporting warehouse employees - Dividing daily tasks and monitoring progress - Making sure operations run efficiently and according to planning - Motivating and guiding your team - Communicating with other departments and management - Identifying problems and helping find practical solutions - Working hands-on with the team when needed 
Who are we looking for? - Experience within logistics or warehousing - Strong communication and organizational skills - Good command of English - A proactive and hands-on mentality - Comfortable taking responsibility and making decisions - Leadership experience is an advantage - Looking for a stable, long-term position
